title: Windows 8.1 Calculator app
lede: A Metro-style app that shows the grammar at small scale: gray key tiles, thin numerals, and one green key.
summary: Flat gray key rectangles with thin white numerals on charcoal, and one solid green equals key. Windows 8.1, 2013.

evidence.note: Inspected [File:Windows 8.1 Calculator.png](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Windows_8.1_Calculator.png) (1920 × 1080; first uploaded 24 October 2013, retaken in 16:9 in April 2022) in a scratchpad copy. Not stored.

styles.note: Clear for the Metro branch: flat rectangles, thin type, and color used only for the one primary key.

context: Commons describes it as “Windows 8.1’s additional Metro-style calculator app in standard mode”.
Microsoft published the Windows Calculator source under the MIT License in 2019 ([microsoft/calculator](https://github.com/microsoft/calculator), repository created 28 January 2019).
observed: The ground is a flat charcoal. Three mode names at top (Standard, Scientific, Converter) are thin type; the active one is white and the others gray.
The display is a slightly lighter gray panel with a thin green line along its top edge and a very thin, very large white “0” at right.
Keys are flat mid-gray rectangles with square corners, separated by narrow dark gaps. Digits and operators are thin white or gray glyphs.
The equals key is the only color: a solid green rectangle with a white sign.
A separate column of memory and function keys is set apart by a wider gap, not by a line.
interpretation: It shows how Metro handles a dense control surface with almost no color: one hue marks the primary action, and space groups the rest.
borrow: In a dense control grid, keep every key the same neutral fill and give only the primary action a saturated color.
Group controls with a wider gap instead of a rule or box.

rights.statement: Commons tags the screenshot as MIT-licensed, but Microsoft’s 2019 MIT release is the Windows 10 Calculator source, and I could not confirm that it covers the Windows 8.1 app. No image is stored here.
